campLine: A small fire, a story still unfolding.
partyHelp: Choose up to two companions you have found.
noCompanions: No companions found yet. Two places await.
loadError: The story could not open. Reload or try again.
portraitHint: Turn your phone to landscape to explore.
tempBody: Temporary seal: the full puzzle arrives in the next phase. Tap to restore this fragment.
rested: Rested. Hearts restored and story saved.
sealsNeeded: Restore all five word seals first.
defeated: Your letters return to the Pondok. A Bayang holds half your Kata.
abilityLater: Your companion waits for something to help with.
chestLocked: Kancil’s small tracks mark this gap.
chestOpened: Your companion retrieves Kata from the chest.
mapHelp: The map fills as you explore. Cleared stages remain open.
futureStage: This stage has not been built yet.
debugBoss: Test guardian framework in this room
lore1: The Great Poet hid stories behind word seals.
lore2: Written words can be remembered again.
lore3: Rest. A restored path will not disappear.
lore4: Even a small voice leaves a trace.
lore5: Five fragments wait to become one story.
lastChance: One final replay remains. Take your time.
storyUnfinished: Their story remains unfinished. The journey continues.
setiaHelp: Loyalty stories are found later in the journey.
debugEnemy: Bring enemy close to test Slash
noHint: No hint available, or not enough Kata.
wrongRemoved: One wrong option is removed for this step.
puzzleWrong: Not quite. Try again; no Kata was lost.
cipherHelp: Tap a cipher code, then a letter to build the idiom.
pushInstruction: Stand south of the pillar. Face north and press Act to push it into the pit.
crossBridge: The pillar becomes a bridge. Walk across it.
riverHelp: Tap a log in the next row to walk towards it, or use the movement pad. Choose words in sentence order.
cardHelp: Turn two cards to find a pair. A mismatch awakens a Letter Guardian.
guardianAwake: A Letter Guardian awakens. Defeat it to resume the cards.
defenceHelp: Choose a word class, then tap a pad to build a tower. Each tower only attacks its own class. Replacing towers refunds their cost.
defenceRetry: Some words escaped. Tap Try again to arrange your defence again.
defencePath: Winding word path with six tower pads
noInkPoints: Not enough ink points. Replace an existing tower.
bossVictory: The roots loosen. A proverb returns, and you receive a heart container.
bossBlocks: Beringin Sunyi still guards the gate.
kancilFound: Kancil: I know the forest’s small paths. May I join you?
kancilBond: Kancil: I remember a voice willing to listen. We will keep the words together.
tutorialRV: Nuri: The right words take us across. Watch each log before stepping.
tutorialTD: Nuri: Names, actions, qualities — each tower knows its class.
tutorialCM: Nuri: Two cards can look different while their meanings connect.
tutorialCR: Nuri: Codes hide letters. The pillar waits until the words are restored.
kind_class-shift: Match roots with their affixed forms
bossStun: The words are understood. Beringin Sunyi is stunned.
bossBuff: The phrase falters. Beringin Sunyi grows stronger.
